children: CONTINUES ITS EXPANSION IN UNITED STATES WITH ACQUISITION OF SAND CHERRY
HAS BEEN FULLY FUNDED WITH CASH FROM WAVESTONE'S EXISTING FINANCIAL RESOURCES
SAND CHERRY WILL BE CONSOLIDATED INTO WAVESTONE'S FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AS OF SEPTEMBER 1, 2026
INITIAL PURCHASE PRICE IS $35.0M (ABOUT €30.1M) ON AN ENTERPRISE VALUE BASIS
ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATION OF UP TO $12.0M (ABOUT €10.3M) CONDITIONED BY SAND CHERRY PERFORMANCE
